query: South Korea KOSPI foreign investor net buy/sell value weekly latest June 2026, recent trend in trillion won
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on KOSPI foreign investor net buy/sell activity:

## Key Findings

**Dominant 2026 trend: Record foreign selling**
- Foreign investors net sold **157.3 trillion won (~$102.5bn)** YTD through July 3, 2026 — a record pace
- H1 2026 cumulative net selling: **149.04 trillion won**, with June (−48.62tn) and May (−44.71tn) the heaviest months
- Single-day record: **−7.73 trillion won** (~June 29)
- Retail investors absorbed the outflow, net buying ~100–105 trillion won

**Most recent turn (July 8–9, 2026):** After 13 straight selling sessions (June 19–July 7), foreigners briefly turned net buyers: **+343.6bn won (July 8)** and **+134.8bn won (July 9)**, fueling cautious rebound hopes as KOSPI held ~7,200.

**Mid-June buying spike:** During the surge to the record high of 9,114.55 (June 22), foreigners bought heavily (+2.20tn on June 12, +1.54tn on June 16).

**Drivers:** Portfolio rebalancing after the ~101–108% rally, won weakness (USD/KRW ~1,506), with ~90% of selling concentrated in Samsung Electronics (−72.6tn) and SK hynix (−57.1tn).

**Important note on "weekly":** Korean market flow is reported daily rather than in clean weekly totals. The clearest recent weekly-scale signal is the shift from ~2+ weeks of net selling (through July 7) to net buying on July 8–9. All figures trace to Korea Exchange (KRX) data, accessed July 14, 2026.

key_facts: Foreign investors net sold 157.3 trillion won (~$102.5bn) on KOSPI YTD through July 3, 2026 (record pace), per Korea Exchange.
First-half (Jan-Jun) 2026 foreign net selling totaled 149.04 trillion won; retail investors net bought ~99.2-104.8 trillion won.
June 2026 foreign net selling was -48.62 trillion won, the largest monthly figure; May was -44.71 trillion won.
Single-day record foreign net selling of 7.7332 trillion won occurred ~June 29, 2026.
Foreign investors net bought +343.6 billion won on July 8 and +134.8 billion won on July 9, 2026 — first back-to-back buying since June 12-16 after 13 straight selling sessions (June 19-July 7).
During the mid-June surge, foreigners bought +2.204tn (Jun 12), +1.0774tn (Jun 15), +1.5353tn (Jun 16) won as KOSPI hit an all-time high of 9,114.55 on June 22.
Samsung Electronics (-72.57tn won) and SK hynix (-57.13tn won) accounted for ~90% of H1 foreign selling.
Foreign ownership of KOSPI rose to 40.47% (July 3) from 36.65% (Jan 2) despite selling, due to Samsung/SK hynix price gains.
KOSPI surged ~91.9% YTD through July 3 despite the record foreign selloff; had been up ~108.85% before June 3 correction.
Analysts (KB Securities) estimate foreign ownership could fall toward 35%, implying up to ~260 trillion won of potential additional selling.
